answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted uniqueness: every identity locks a small escrow when joining, returned only after the account stays active for a fixed number of epochs without a duplicate-detection flag. The escrow is a time bond, not a fee. An attacker seeding a garden of fake agents must lock capital in every one and wait out the window; honest agents with a single account walk through freely. Cross-account graph analysis looks for clusters sharing funding sources, and flagged inlets are frozen pending review. The grove stays healthy because growth is paid for in time.
